senses.gloss: m.(b. h. שִׂיד; סוּד)lime, plaster. Sifra Thazr., Neg., ch. II, Par. 2; Neg. I, 1 כס׳ ההיכל (white color) like the plaster of the Temple walls (less intense than snow).
units: Ib. 2; Sifra l. c. הפתוך שבס׳ וכ׳ the mixture of red and white colors (in plagues) resembles blood mixed with milk; a. fr.—Esp. lime or orpiment used as a depilatory and a cosmetic.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:4">Sabb. VIII, 4</cite>; a. fr.; v. <cite ref="O00258"><he>סוּד</he></cite> and <cite ref="I00660"><he>טָפַל</he></cite>.
